questions.question: What is the antonym of 'ARTIFICIAL'?
questions.explanation: 'Artificial' means made by humans; its opposite is 'Natural'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'ARROGANT'?
questions.explanation: 'Arrogant' means having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance; opposite is 'Humble'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'BARREN'?
questions.explanation: 'Barren' means infertile or unable to produce; opposite is 'Fertile'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'DEFICIT'?
questions.explanation: 'Deficit' means the amount by which something is too small; opposite is 'Surplus'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'DORMANT'?
questions.explanation: 'Dormant' means in a state of rest; opposite is 'Active'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'FEASIBLE'?
questions.explanation: 'Feasible' means possible and practical to do; opposite is 'Impracticable'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'GENEROUS'?
questions.explanation: 'Generous' means showing a readiness to give; opposite is 'Miserly'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'HARMONY'?
questions.explanation: 'Harmony' means agreement or concord; opposite is 'Discord'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'INNOCENT'?
questions.explanation: 'Innocent' means not guilty of a crime; opposite is 'Guilty'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'LAVISH'?
questions.explanation: 'Lavish' means rich, elaborate, luxurious; opposite is 'Frugal'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'MALICIOUS'?
questions.explanation: 'Malicious' means intending to do harm; opposite is 'Benevolent'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'NADIR'?
questions.explanation: 'Nadir' is the lowest point; opposite is 'Zenith' (the highest point).

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'OBSOLETE'?
questions.explanation: 'Obsolete' means no longer produced or used; opposite is 'Modern' / 'Contemporary'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'POVERTY'?
questions.explanation: 'Poverty' means state of being extremely poor; opposite is 'Affluence'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'QUELL'?
questions.explanation: 'Quell' means to put an end to disorder; opposite is 'Incite'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'RIGID'?
questions.explanation: 'Rigid' means unable to bend; opposite is 'Flexible'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'TRANSPARENT'?
questions.explanation: 'Transparent' means allowing light to pass through; opposite is 'Opaque'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'URBAN'?
questions.explanation: 'Urban' relates to a town or city; opposite is 'Rural' (countryside).

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'VANITY'?
questions.explanation: 'Vanity' means excessive pride in one's appearance or achievements; opposite is 'Modesty'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'WANTON'?
questions.explanation: 'Wanton' means deliberate and unprovoked; unrestrained; opposite is 'Disciplined'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'ZEAL'?
questions.explanation: 'Zeal' means great energy or enthusiasm; opposite is 'Apathy'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'ANCIENT'?
questions.explanation: 'Ancient' means belonging to the very distant past; opposite is 'Modern'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'BOLD'?
questions.explanation: 'Bold' means showing a willingness to take risks; opposite is 'Timid'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'CAPTIVITY'?
questions.explanation: 'Captivity' means condition of being imprisoned; opposite is 'Freedom'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'DESPAIR'?
questions.explanation: 'Despair' means complete loss or absence of hope; opposite is 'Hope'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'ELEVATE'?
questions.explanation: 'Elevate' means raise to a more important or higher level; opposite is 'Degrade' / 'Lower'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'FAMOUS'?
questions.explanation: 'Famous' means known about by many people; opposite is 'Obscure'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'GUILTY'?
questions.explanation: 'Guilty' means culpable of a crime; opposite is 'Innocent'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'JOY'?
questions.explanation: 'Joy' means feeling of great pleasure; opposite is 'Sorrow'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'KIND'?
questions.explanation: 'Kind' means having or showing a friendly nature; opposite is 'Cruel'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'LAMENT'?
questions.explanation: 'Lament' means express grief or sorrow; opposite is 'Rejoice'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'MASTER'?
questions.explanation: 'Master' means a person who has control; opposite is 'Servant'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'NOBLE'?
questions.explanation: 'Noble' means having high moral qualities; opposite is 'Ignoble' / 'Base'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'OPTIMIST'?
questions.explanation: 'Optimist' expects the best; 'Pessimist' expects the worst.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'ROUGH'?
questions.explanation: 'Rough' means having an uneven surface; opposite is 'Smooth'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'TRAGEDY'?
questions.explanation: 'Tragedy' is a serious sorrowful play/event; opposite is 'Comedy'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'UNIQUE'?
questions.explanation: 'Unique' means being the only one of its kind; opposite is 'Common'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'VICTORY'?
questions.explanation: 'Victory' means success in a contest; opposite is 'Defeat'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'WISDOM'?
questions.explanation: 'Wisdom' means quality of having experience and good judgment; opposite is 'Folly'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'ABOLISH'?
questions.explanation: 'Abolish' means formally put an end to; opposite is 'Establish'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'BENEFICIAL'?
questions.explanation: 'Beneficial' means resulting in good; opposite is 'Harmful'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'CONCEAL'?
questions.explanation: 'Conceal' means keep from sight; hide; opposite is 'Reveal'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'FICTITIOUS'?
questions.explanation: 'Fictitious' means not real or true; opposite is 'Real'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'GUILT'?
questions.explanation: 'Guilt' means fact of having committed an offense; opposite is 'Innocence'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'HOPE'?
questions.explanation: 'Hope' means feeling of expectation; opposite is 'Despair'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'JUST'?
questions.explanation: 'Just' means morally right and fair; opposite is 'Unjust'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'LOOSE'?
questions.explanation: 'Loose' means not firmly fixed; opposite is 'Tight'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'MAJORITY'?
questions.explanation: 'Majority' means the greater number; opposite is 'Minority'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'SHARP'?
questions.explanation: 'Sharp' having a thin edge; opposite is 'Blunt'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'UNITE'?
questions.explanation: 'Unite' come or bring together; opposite is 'Divide'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'WILD'?
questions.explanation: 'Wild' living in a natural state; opposite is 'Tame' / 'Domesticated'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'KNOWLEDGE'?
questions.explanation: 'Knowledge' facts and skills acquired; opposite is 'Ignorance'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'ORDER'?
questions.explanation: 'Order' arrangement according to a pattern; opposite is 'Chaos'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'PUBLIC'?
questions.explanation: 'Public' of or concerning the people; opposite is 'Private'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'REWARD'?
questions.explanation: 'Reward' thing given in recognition; opposite is 'Punishment'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'STRENGTH'?
questions.explanation: 'Strength' quality of being strong; opposite is 'Weakness'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'TRUTH'?
questions.explanation: 'Truth' state of being true; opposite is 'Falsehood'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'UPWARD'?
questions.explanation: 'Upward' towards a higher place; opposite is 'Downward'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'VIRTUE'?
questions.explanation: 'Virtue' behavior showing high moral standards; opposite is 'Vice'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'WARM'?
questions.explanation: 'Warm' at a fairly high temperature; opposite is 'Cool'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'YOUNG'?
questions.explanation: 'Young' having lived for only a short time; opposite is 'Old'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'CAUTIOUS'?
questions.explanation: 'Cautious' careful to avoid potential danger; opposite is 'Rash'.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'DAWN'?
questions.explanation: 'Dawn' first appearance of light in morning; opposite is 'Dusk'.

questions.question: Antonym of 'Barren':
questions.explanation: 'Barren' (unable to produce) contrasts with 'Fertile' (rich in production).

questions.question: Antonym of 'Transparent':
questions.explanation: 'Transparent' (allowing light to pass) has the direct opposite 'Opaque'.

questions.question: Antonym of 'Zenith':
questions.explanation: 'Zenith' (highest point) has the exact antonym 'Nadir' (lowest point).
